results.title: Fleet Manager – FMCG & Logistics
results.description: Job Title Fleet Manager – FMCG & Logistics Job Description A leading UAE-based food manufacturing and grain processing organization is seeking an experienced Fleet Manager to oversee fleet operations across Ajman, Fujairah, and Sharjah . This role is responsible for managing vehicles, drivers, route optimization, cost control, safety compliance, and operational efficiency across multiple facilities. Key Responsibilities Plan and monitor transportation and delivery schedules to ensure timely product delivery Oversee daily fleet operations including trucks, vans, and logistics vehicles Optimize routing to minimize fuel consumption and transit time Develop and implement preventive maintenance schedules Ensure all vehicles meet safety and regulatory standards (licenses, permits, inspections) Enforce safety protocols and investigate incidents Manage fleet-related expenses including fuel, maintenance, insurance, and depreciation Identify and implement cost-saving initiatives Hire, train, and manage drivers; monitor performance and provide feedback Ensure RTA compliance and maintain accurate fleet records Prepare performance and cost reports for senior management Implement fleet management software and GPS tracking systems Stay updated on fleet technology innovations Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Logistics, Supply Chain, Business Administration, or related field 10+ years of fleet management experience, preferably in FMCG Experience managing large fleets and external service providers UAE logistics experience is a strong advantage Key Competencies Strong operational efficiency and logistics planning skills Budget management and cost control expertise Proven leadership and people management abilities Excellent problem-solving and decision-making skills Data-driven approach with KPI analysis In-depth knowledge of RTA regulations and transportation laws Strong communication and cross-functional coordination skills Job Details Location: Ajman, Fujairah & Sharjah, UAE Employment Type: Full-time Experience Level: Senior / Managerial Industry: FMCG / Food Manufacturing / Logistics Reporting To: Managing Director Compensation & Benefits Competitive tax-free salary Annual performance bonus Health insurance Annual flight tickets Other benefits per UAE labor law

results.title: Fleet Manager
results.description: Position Objective As the key liaison between BYD and the Saudi importer for Fleet business, the Fleet Manager is responsible for driving Fleet sales growth, establishing a structured key account and Sub-dealer management system, and ensuring healthy channel operations. This role will coordinate customer allocation across Dealers, Sub-dealers, and the Fleet team to prevent channel conflicts and unhealthy competition while maximizing overall sales performance. Key Objectives: Drive Fleet business growth by developing government, corporate, rental, and strategic customers. Build a structured key account management system to enhance customer satisfaction and long-term partnerships. Balance customer allocation among Dealers, Sub-dealers, and the Fleet team to prevent customer conflicts and price competition. Improve Sub-dealer performance and operational efficiency to increase overall market share. Key Responsibilities Fleet Customer Development & Relationship Management Develop and execute Fleet customer acquisition plans targeting government entities, corporate customers, rental companies, and other strategic accounts. Build and maintain long-term relationships with key customers to improve customer retention and repeat business. Lead major Fleet projects by coordinating sales, delivery, and after-sales resources to ensure customer satisfaction. Fleet Sales & Project Management Develop Fleet sales plans based on annual targets and monitor the sales pipeline, order status, and vehicle deliveries to ensure target achievement. Regularly review sales performance and project progress, driving the successful execution of key Fleet opportunities while resolving business issues promptly. Customer Allocation & Channel Management Establish clear customer allocation rules among Dealers, Sub-dealers, and the Fleet team to ensure transparent customer ownership and project management. Resolve channel conflicts, prevent customer poaching, duplicate customer development, and destructive price competition to maintain a healthy sales network. Sub-dealer Business Management Set sales targets for Sub-dealers and continuously monitor their sales performance, inventory, and business development. Drive the expansion and performance improvement of Exclusive Sub-dealers, increasing their contribution to overall sales through targeted action plans. Business Analysis & Strategic Planning Analyze Fleet sales performance, customer development, sales pipeline, and Sub-dealer business performance on a regular basis. Monitor competitor Fleet activities, pricing strategies, and market trends, providing insights and recommendations to optimize sales strategies and commercial policies. Cross-functional Coordination & Problem Solving Organize regular Fleet business review meetings and coordinate with the importer and internal departments to resolve commercial, delivery, and after-sales issues. Drive issue resolution, project follow-up, and continuous process improvement to enhance Fleet sales efficiency and channel operations.

results.title: Rider Operations Manager
results.description: Key Accountability Areas Rider Operations Develop effective processes to optimize delivery efficiency while ensuring rider satisfaction and adherence to regulations. Ensure operations run smoothly, efficiently, and in compliance with all relevant regulations. Manage rider equipment and uniforms. Monitor and control operational costs related to rider operations while maintaining service quality. Utilize technology and data to optimize delivery routes and improve efficiency. Identify opportunities to enhance rider operations through the implementation of new tools and systems. Develop and maintain key performance indicator (KPI) dashboards, providing regular reports to senior management on rider operations' performance, trends, and areas requiring attention. Manage the overall rider experience and communication such as Rider Pay, Rider NPS, rider churn rate, Rider’s Early Life Cycle (New rider experience), and rider recruitment in regard to onboarding and training. Manage the rider support team and dispatch team in terms of SOPs and service Level. Manage and maintain rider earnings and CPO through rider payment system and incentives. Manage the communication channels of riders and rider app functionality. Increase the daily active rider’s supply. Manage compliance with CITC. Strategy & Planning Contribute to the development and execution of the Division’s ABCs and OKRs, while ensuring alignment with other Functions' heads. Make critical decisions that support the Division's strategic and tactical direction. Establish the plans for the respective functions/teams and provide inputs that support the Division’s goals and objectives. Distribute tactical responsibilities effectively to potential leaders in the Division, to improve the succession readiness of the organization over time. Measure and track the Division's OKRs and metrics to ensure the achievement of goals and take corrective actions when necessary. Governance and Resilience Follow all relevant policies, procedures, and processes for the daily work to be carried out in a controlled and consistent manner. Contribute to the identification of opportunities for continuous improvement of processes and practices to enhance effectiveness. Uphold a high-performance working environment and promote HS’s Values. People Management Set performance objectives, provide necessary support, evaluate direct reports, and provide regular feedback on performance. Participate in the identification and recruitment of key talents for the function. Provide clear direction, prioritize tasks, assign and delegate responsibility, and monitor the workflow. Provide opportunities for team members to suggest, participate in, and contribute to improvement, innovation, and knowledge-sharing initiatives. Budget Management Manage and own the budgeting cycle and provide input to the budgeting process. Ensure effective utilization of the function's budget, and report accurately on progress and challenges. Investigate and propose implementing strategies that result in a positive financial impact for HS. Manage the reporting departments effectively within budget, and report accurately on progress made and challenges encountered. Formulate strategies that result in a positive financial impact for HS and aim to mitigate financial and operational risks. Project Management Lead and guide the project management team in planning and organizing divisional or functional projects for their respective divisions. Direct and control projects to ensure that project cycles are completed, and parameters (cost budget, timelines, scope, and quality) are met, monitored, and in line with the required quality and standards. Lead initiatives and growth projects aligning concerned functions for seamless execution. Stakeholders' Relations Establish and maintain good working relationships with the key stakeholders internally and externally. Inform stakeholders of the relevant HS's actions and decisions. Qualifications/ Requirements Knowledge and Experience 6 - 8 years of relevant experience. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Knowledge of relevant software and tools for route optimization and tracking. Leadership and team management Education and Certifications Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Logistics, or a relevant field is required. A master’s degree in a relevant field is preferred.

results.title: Aerodrome Operations Manager
results.description: Aerodrome Operations Manager is responsible for overseeing all operations, management and coordinating the facilities maintenance of Fixed Based Operation (FBO) with aerodrome maintenance division. Manage and supervise team of aerodrome and FBO staff, including passenger handling staff, ground handling crew, ensuring the highest level of customer service, operational efficiency, safety and regulatory compliance. Responsible to attend meeting with airport authorities and stakeholders, manage day to day operations, coordinate with internal and external teams, and drive performance improvement to support the growth and success of FBO service at the airport. Ensure that all operational activities comply with GACAR 151 requirements. Work closely with aerodrome maintenance team to ensure the readiness and safety of GSE and aerodrome facilities. Conduct safety briefings and training session for staff to reinforce the importance of safety. Prepare and submit reports on operations, employee performance and financial performance. Ensure that all necessary documentation is maintained and updated as required by Airport regulatory authorities. Conduct regular performance evaluation and foster a positive, collaborative and safe work environment. Handle any special requests or needs from passengers or crew, ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction. Performs other operational, safety or management duties as directed by the Ground Services Operations Manager or higher management. Areas of Accountabilities: Performs all managerial functions common to the organization level such as flight operational reports, personnel actions, training and development of staff members. Coordinates turnaround movement of fixed & rotor wing aircraft to ensure efficient movement of passengers/cargo/mail. Ensure qualified Ground Support Equipment (GSE) & personnel are available to load/unload aircraft at Airport, while assuring minimal passenger inconvenience. Directs and monitors preparation of necessary documentation: Aircraft flight release forms, weight & balance forms, passenger/cargo/mail manifests, morning activity & status reports, computer inputs, fuel reports etc. Directs to submit requests for buses and taxis for company’s personnel/passengers. Responsible to maintain and coordinates all facilities maintenance activities in the airport in addition to action safety inspection deficiencies, terminal security, maintenance work orders & office services requests by coordinating with internal and external entities at Airport. Reviews time sheets and contract service entry sheets for ground operations contractor staff. Manages janitorial, administrative, transportation and operational needs with external entities. Inspects condition of aerodrome facilities and vehicles to ensure all areas and equipment are maintained and company standards are met. Monitors radio operations in order to ensure compliance with GACA, IATA, ICAO radio communications regulations. Responsible to maintain stock inventories related to ground operations, passenger handling, terminal requirements, facilities and safety items in the airport. Provides information & cooperation with Safety Review Board as requested. Coordinates with implementation of directives from Safety & Security Division. Responsible to perform public relations activities requiring meet and assist VIP passengers, distinguished visitors or while coordinating efforts with Saudi Government officials and others. Ensure compliance to all relevant safety, security, quality and environmental management policies, procedures and controls across the operations to ensure safety, security, legislative compliance and delivery of high-quality service with a responsible environmental attitude. Communicate timely with Ground Services Operations Manager on matters affecting operations and requiring attention or intervention. Performs other operational, safety or management duties as directed by the Ground Services Operations Manager or higher management. Education: Bachelor’s degree in aviation industry / hospitality or equivalent in relevant field. Professional Qualifications: IATA or Airline certifications on airport handling experience. Management and Leadership Certifications Experience: Minimum of 10 years of experience in airport ground operations and FBO management, with at least 5 years in a manager or supervisory role.

results.description: Company Description Oh Yes Events Private Limited is a full-service event management company recognized for creatively designing and executing events that align closely with each client’s vision. The team meticulously plans both the micro and macro aspects of wedding and special events, acting as a one-stop partner for all event-related requirements. With expertise in building unique themes and recreating customized experiences, the company focuses on delivering high levels of client satisfaction for every project. Oh Yes Events operates with a strong sense of passion, attention to detail, and a client-centric approach, powered by positivity, agile leadership, and a commitment to going beyond expectations in Chennai, India and Dubai, UAE. Role Description The Head of Operations & Project Management is a full-time, on-site role based in Dubai, responsible for overseeing end-to-end planning and execution of events. This role leads cross-functional teams to ensure smooth operations, from initial client briefing and concept development to vendor coordination, logistics, on-ground management, and post-event review. The position involves designing and implementing operational processes, resource planning, budgeting, and risk management to deliver high-quality, immersive event experiences. The Head of Operations & Project Management will maintain strong client relationships, translate client requirements into actionable project plans, and drive continuous improvement across locations, aligning teams with the company’s values and performance standards. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong operations and project management skills, including resource planning, workflow optimization, risk management, and end-to-end project delivery. Candidates should possess expertise in event management and production, including vendor coordination, logistics planning, on-site execution, and quality assurance for large-scale events. Candidates should possess leadership and people management skills, including team building, performance management, cross-functional collaboration, and the ability to drive change. Candidates should possess client-facing skills, including stakeholder management, negotiation, solution-focused communication, and the ability to translate client needs into executable plans. Candidates should possess analytical and organizational skills, including budgeting, timeline management, data-driven decision-making, and attention to detail. Experience in the events industry, hospitality, or related domains, preferably in international or multicultural environments. Bachelor’s degree in business, event management, operations, or a related field; advanced certifications in project management (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2) are an advantage. Ability to work flexible hours, including evenings and weekends, based on event schedules; proficiency in relevant project management and collaboration tools. results.title: Head of Operations
results.description: About Us We're a branded residential platform that aims to elevate apartment living through thoughtful design, hospitality-level service, and community — bringing the kind of branding and experience you see in luxury hotels into the residential sector. We're growing fast across Riyadh, with more properties launching soon, and we're looking for someone to help us scale operations without losing the quality and experience that sets us apart. The Role We're hiring a Head of Operations to take ownership of day-to-day operations across our residential portfolio. This is a hands-on, on-the-ground role — you'll be managing and coaching our General Managers, working closely with Facilities, Revenue, and other internal teams, and building the systems and processes that let us scale without losing our standards. This is not a strategy-from-behind-a-desk role. You'll be out at our properties regularly, solving real problems as they come up — from resident experience issues to procurement and facilities challenges — and building the playbooks that let our GMs run great buildings consistently. What You'll Do Manage and coach General Managers across our residential properties, absorbing the layer of day-to-day oversight currently sitting with senior leadership Work cross-functionally with Facilities, Revenue, and other internal stakeholders to keep operations running smoothly Design, implement, and continuously improve SOPs — from high-level operating processes down to on-the-ground fixes (procurement standardization, vendor issues, building-level problems) Drive the rollout of new operational initiatives and workflows across the portfolio Be a visible, credible presence on-site — someone who can speak comfortably with cleaners, contractors, and vendors as easily as with General Managers Support the operational readiness of new properties as we continue to expand What We're Looking For high-energy operator with genuine stamina for a hands-on, on-the-ground role — this is not a remote or HQ-only job Strong consumer-facing operational experience — ideally from a tech or prop-tech scale-up that has grown from a handful of physical sites to 10+, though strong hospitality or resort operations experience is also a great fit A track record of scaling operations — taking a business or team from a small footprint to a much larger one A true builder: someone who has designed processes and systems from scratch in a resource-constrained or early-stage environment A coaching leadership style — someone who invests in underperforming team members and helps them grow, rather than defaulting to replacing them Comfort operating in ambiguity, without needing a rigid corporate structure to lean on Strong academic and analytical foundation (a plus, not a requirement — we care more about demonstrated rigor than pedigree) Real estate experience is a bonus, not a requirement. Same goes for Saudi-specific experience — we're open to great operators from anywhere who are excited to relocate to Riyadh
